title: Writing: About Your Feelings
writingModel: I am a second-year student at WKU and I want to write about how I feel about my studies.

I enjoy studying English because it opens many doors. I love learning new vocabulary — it feels like collecting treasures. However, I sometimes hate making mistakes when I speak in front of the class.
I decided to practise speaking more this semester. I hope to join the English debate club. I also plan to find a language partner — someone to practise with twice a week.
I avoid procrastinating because I know it makes me feel worse. I keep reminding myself: every small step matters.
I feel proud of how far I have come. One year ago, I was afraid to speak English at all. Now I am writing about my feelings in English — and that is a great achievement.
